name: Zydus Lifesciences Ltd.
business_summary: Ahmedabad-based diversified pharma: US generics and specialty (US ~42% of Q2 sales, Rs 3,315 cr), India formulations and consumer wellness, emerging markets, APIs and recent medical-device/biologics acquisitions. TTM sales Rs 30,378 cr (+24%), but Q2 FY27 operating margin fell to 24% (from 33%) and PAT dropped 27% to Rs 928 cr. Borrowings rose to Rs 13,966 cr after acquisitions. USFDA closed an inspection of the Moraiya plant with 5 observations (data integrity/QC flagged by NDTV Profit, 2026-10-26).

revenue_mix.geography: various (model estimate; only US share is sourced)

exposures.mechanism: US ~42% of Q2 sales (Rs 3,315 cr of Rs 7,910 cr). +3% USD/INR: US revenue +1.3% of group sales; other USD/EUR revenue ~10% adds 0.3%; imported RM/API ~12% of sales -0.35% => +1.2% of sales / OPM 24% = +5% EBITDA; hedged ~50% near-term, persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 1.1 -> +2.8. Empirical +3.31 (t=2.4) agrees in sign, higher.

evidence.note: Q2 FY27: profit -27% YoY, OPM 24% vs 33%, US revenue Rs 3,315 cr; stock -4% after 52-week high (CNBC TV18, Zee Business, Upstox)

exposures.mechanism: Moraiya (Ahmedabad) closed with 5 observations incl. data-integrity/QC (Oct 2026). Moraiya is a large US-supply site (est. 20-25% of US sales -> ~10% of group sales; model estimate). OAI/Warning Letter risk 25% x impact (-12% value: EBITDA -6%, approvals delayed, multiple cut) + other-site risk -> -5 weighted.
